notes.title: Big Thanks to you guys all!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11976937/445b7c2d4d442738a730c61cc51d48c3b86f27b0.png[/img]

Hello Fans & Friends:

It's really honor and happy to let you guys know, Lamia's Game Room ​ has won the Best Game Art in Indie Prize at Casual Connect Asia​ 2016.

We wanted to say thanks to all the judges, families and friends.
More importantly, YOU GUYS! (Players and Fans).

As some of the people might knew that "Lamia's game room" is one of our early games when we officially started Digital Crafter​.
We knew it is not great, There are still a big improvement we can do with it. We will see this winning experience as our big encouragement, and try to make our game better and better in every way.

Thanks again to all the Fans and Players!! We thank you and We love you guys so much!!! oxoxoxoxoxoːsteamhappyː
